title: How Police Captured Colorado's Smartest Killer

beats.description: Cold open showing Crystal's mother finding her body and Daniel leaving for work after murder
Introduction to Crystal, Daniel, and the stalker narrative; police check car for trackers
Daniel reports break-in; stalker messages begin; Crystal's fear escalates
Stalker sends photo of Daniel at work; Crystal hires PI; police interview with Detective Martinez
Sponsor segment for Outskill AI training
Daniel's interview reveals marriage troubles; Martinez considers Daniel as possible suspect
Stalker messages intensify; Crystal feels relief but it's a trap; murder occurs
Crystal's body discovered; officers find stab wound; family arrives; Daniel's emotional act
Daughter reveals stalker manipulated family; cameras turned off; Daniel becomes suspect
Family interviews raise suspicions; Anthony found in Utah with alibi; ex-girlfriend Carrie's story
Digital evidence ties stalker emails to Daniel's workplace; Anthony's alibi confirmed
Second interrogation: Martinez confronts Daniel with evidence; Daniel asks for lawyer
Final evidence arrives: burner phones, gift card, Google searches; arrest warrant issued
Daniel arrested at daughter's dance; case closed; narrator summarizes the plot
